items.headline: USA Advances After Balogun Red Card
items.body: The U.S. Men's National Team defeated Bosnia and Herzegovina 2-0 in Santa Clara, California, to secure their spot in the Round of 16. Folarin Balogun scored in the 45th minute but was later sent off with a red card in the 64th, making the victory a hard-fought one for the ten-man USMNT. Malik Tillman sealed the win with a free-kick goal in the 82nd minute.

metadata.venue: San Francisco Bay Area Stadium, Santa Clara, California

items.headline: Belgium Stages Dramatic Comeback
items.body: Belgium rallied from a two-goal deficit to defeat Senegal 3-2 after extra time in Seattle. Youri Tielemans scored a 125th-minute penalty to complete the comeback, keeping Belgium's title hopes alive. Romelu Lukaku and Tielemans also scored late in regular time to force extra time.

items.headline: England Fights Back Against DR Congo
items.body: England secured a 2-1 victory over DR Congo in the Round of 32, with Harry Kane scoring twice in the final 15 minutes. The late goals saw England overcome a resilient Democratic Republic of Congo side to advance to the next round.

items.headline: Spain Dominates Austria 3-0
items.body: Spain delivered a dominant performance, defeating Austria 3-0 in Los Angeles to progress to the Round of 16. Real Sociedad forward Mikel Oyarzabal scored a brace, with Pedro Porro adding another goal.

metadata.venue: Venue to be confirmed, Los Angeles

items.headline: Paraguay Eliminates Germany on Penalties
items.body: Paraguay advanced to the Round of 16 after a dramatic penalty shootout victory over Germany, following a 1-1 draw in regular time. Germany is now eliminated from the tournament.

items.headline: Paquetá Out for Tournament
items.body: Brazil has suffered a significant blow with Lucas Paquetá ruled out for the remainder of the World Cup due to a muscle injury in his left thigh. The Confederação Brasileira de Futebol confirmed the injury after imaging tests.

items.headline: Kone Suffers Severe Leg Fracture
items.body: Canada midfielder Ismael Kone will miss the rest of the tournament after undergoing successful surgery for severe fractures in his lower left leg. The injury, sustained during a group-stage match, involved both the tibia and fibula bones.

items.headline: Neymar Returns to Action
items.body: Neymar made his long-awaited return for Brazil in their final group game against Scotland, coming off the bench for a cameo appearance. He had been sidelined with a calf injury.

items.headline: Colombia vs. Ghana
items.body: Colombia will face Ghana in a crucial Round of 32 encounter. Both teams will be looking to secure a spot in the Round of 16 in what is expected to be a closely contested match.

items.headline: Argentina vs. Cape Verde
items.body: Defending champions Argentina, led by Lionel Messi, will take on Cape Verde in the Round of 32. Argentina enters the match after winning their group with a perfect record.

items.headline: Portugal vs. Croatia
items.body: Portugal and Croatia will clash in a highly anticipated Round of 32 match at BMO Field. Both teams finished as runners-up in their respective groups and have no reported injury concerns for this fixture.
